mechanism_claims.claim_text: D-RR4 damages bacterial membranes in P. aeruginosa PAO1, supported by NPN outer-membrane permeabilization, propidium-iodide cytoplasmic-membrane permeabilization, ATP leakage, and TEM membrane-damage observations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Supplementary Fig. 4/5 curve and image measurements are not available as local structured numeric tables; the claim is qualitative/mechanistic rather than a reconstructed numeric figure dataset.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RR and D-RR4 bind/neutralize LPS in LAL assays and reduce LPS-induced TNF-alpha and IL-6 release from J774A.1 macrophages; D-RR4 shows stronger inhibition at matched concentrations in the reported text.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local text supports percent inhibition values at selected concentrations; no additional supplementary raw cytokine table is locally present.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: D-RR4 has in vivo antibacterial efficacy context in C. elegans infection models, reducing bacterial burden and improving survival alone or with colistin depending on the bacterial strain.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports in vivo efficacy context, not a separate molecular mechanism beyond membrane/LPS assays.
